question: Which of the following books won the Man Booker International Prize in the year 2019?
solution:
The correct naswer is __**Celestial Bodies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jokha Alharthi:__

 __
 
• She is the first woman from Oman who won Man Booker International Prize 2019__ for her book "__Celestial Body__".
 
• In this novel, she tells about the story of three sisters and a desert country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• In 2019 Margaret Atwood and Bernardine Evaristo won Manbooker Prize in 2019 for the book "The Testament" and "Girl, Woman, and Other" respectively.
